test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the correctly spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **Tolerate**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• "Tolerate" is the correct spelling.
 
• The spellings of other words are absolutely incorrect.
 
• Tolerate refers to accepting actions and viewpoints that differ from your own, even if you don't agree with or support them.
 
 
• Example: *Our teacher warned us that she will not tolerate this kind of behaviour. *
 
 

The correct spelling is Tolerate.
